_about: Lower bounds proved in Astra's second batch (contrib/astra-2026-11-24b), checked there. Field -> bound, with the reason.

max_follow: every lane word is one of 6 permutations, so two of the 9 bowlers share all 3 pairs; meeting 3 times in trios repeats a follow direction

max_meet: a cap of 2 forces every met couple to meet exactly twice, but each bowler has 21 opponent slots (odd)
a cap of 3 is a lane-exact resolvable 2-(12,4,3) design, i.e. a GBTD(4,3), which does not exist (Chee, Kiah, Wang 2013)
neg_min_meet: min_meet 3 would make every couple meet exactly 3 times (198 incidences, 66 couples): a GBTD(4,3), which does not exist (Astra, third batch)

max_meet: one meeting is a KTS(15); none of the 7 has a balanced 5-lane allocation (exhaustive)
one meeting needs 24 permutations of 6 symbols at Hamming distance >= 5; at most 18 exist
one meeting plus 6 constant rows gives two orthogonal Latin squares of order 6
